[project]
name = "fristenmanagement"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "FastAPI service for managing deadlines in formal administrative processes"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
dependencies = [
    "fastapi[standard]>=0.135.0",
    "prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator>=7.1.0",
    "psycopg[binary]>=3.2.10",
    "sqlalchemy>=2.0.43",
    "python-dotenv>=1.2.2",
    "asyncpg>=0.29.0",
    "pydantic-settings>=2.14.2",
    "urllib3>=2.6.0",
    "idna>=3.15",
    "starlette>=1.3.1",
    "python-multipart>=0.0.31",
]

[project.scripts]
fristenmanagement = "fristenmanagement:main.main"
fristenmanagement-dev = "fristenmanagement:main.dev"
export-openapi-json = "fristenmanagement.scripts:export_openapi.export_openapi_json"

[build-system]
requires = [
    "hatchling",
]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "pre-commit>=4.2.0",
    "ruff>=0.11.0",
    "mypy>=1.17.0",
    "bandit>=1.8.0",
    "pytest>=9.0.3",
    "pytest-asyncio>=0.24.0",
    "pylint>=3.3.8",
    "pylint-pydantic>=0.3.5",
    "pytest-cov>=7.0.0",
]
test = [
    "faker>=37.8.0",
    "pytest>=9.0.2",
    "pytest-asyncio>=1.2.0",
    "pytest-cov>=7.0.0",
    "pytest-mock>=3.14.0",
    "tomli>=2.3.0",
    "pytest-docker>=3.2.5",
    "pytest-env>=1.2.0",
    "freezegun>=1.5.5",
    "psycopg[binary]>=3.3.2",
    "asgi-lifespan>=2",
    "filelock>=3.20.3",
    "pygments>=2.20.0",
    "virtualenv>=20.36.1",
]

[project]
name = "decision-log-store-service"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Persists BMDS inference decision-logs to PostgreSQL"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12,<3.13"
authors = [
    { name = "BMDS-SPARK-API Team", email = "bmds-spark-api@example.de" },
]
keywords = [
    "decision-log",
    "bmds",
    "fastapi",
    "postgresql",
    "rabbitmq",
]
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 4 - Beta",
    "Framework :: FastAPI",
    "Intended Audience :: Developers",
    "Operating System :: OS Independent",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
    "Typing :: Typed",
]
dependencies = [
    "fastapi[standard]==0.139.0",
    "opentelemetry-api==1.43.0",
    "opentelemetry-sdk==1.43.0",
    "opentelemetry-instrumentation-fastapi==0.64b0",
    "opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http==1.43.0",
    "prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator==8.0.2",
    "prometheus-client>=0.26.0",
    "bizlog",
    "sqlmodel>=0.0.39",
    "alembic>=1.18.5",
    "psycopg[binary]>=3.1.0",
    "pydantic-settings>=2.14.2",
    "pkg-decision-protocol",
    "lark>=1.2.2",
    "aio-pika==10.0.1",
]

[project.scripts]
decision-log-store-service = "decision_log_store_service.main:main"
decision-log-store-service-dev = "decision_log_store_service.main:dev"

[build-system]
requires = [
    "hatchling",
]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "pre-commit>=4.6.2",
    "mypy==2.2.0",
    "pylint==4.0.6",
    "pylint-pydantic==0.4.1",
    "ruff==0.15.21",
